rules: Check canonical identity and all aliases before generating.
Existing jokelet files block routine regeneration regardless of review/approval status. Review or repair the existing output first.
Reserve the canonical joke for the batch before any paid request; record run and provider job IDs. This file is an operator record, not an atomic multi-worker lock.
A failure is a resumable attempt, not a new joke. Check outstanding jobs/charges before retrying.
Changed wording, tone or reaction does not by itself make a new underlying joke.
Reusing a completed jokelet in an episode is allowed; manufacturing its source again is a separate, explicit regeneration.
No numeric batch budget is set by the eventual whole-library goal.
Follow existing source-library order, resolving canonical identity before reservation; no familiar-joke shortcut.
A mixed, captioned, rejected or automation-ineligible finished output still counts as produced. Rebuild as a version of the existing joke, never as a new joke.
Editorial approval, clean-source automation eligibility and rebuild completeness are independent checks. Missing source links must remain explicit.
